amount.description: Decimal cents as supplied by the provider (exact; never a float). At most 64 characters and 18 fractional digits. The whole part (leading zeros allowed) must be at most 17014118346046923173168730371588410: cents() converts to micro-USD in i128 (checked_mul by 10000) and refuses larger values. The boundary value itself is additionally refused when its first four fractional digits exceed 5727 (or round up past i128::MAX), which the pattern does not express.

MoneyPlatformExploreRedactedKey.description: Personal-workspace keys are collapsed into one row; no key id or name is ever exposed.

MoneyPlatformExploreIdentified.description: Any other identified group: a workspace, model, provider, cost center, key, member or day. Key privacy on personal-workspace rows is enforced by the handler (the platform key dimension in src/management/usage.rs collapses every personal-workspace key into the redacted row, with a null id) and asserted by the executed fixture for the key id and the key name under both platform actors; the schema does not enforce it. In particular this branch does not exclude the redacted label: key names are free text, so a key of a shared workspace may carry the same name as the redacted row and is a legitimate identified row.
